cohort: 87 children with ASD and 174 children without ASD in Al-Madina Al-Munawarah city, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
finding: The study found an association between delivery by cesarean section and ASD, with an adjusted odds ratio of 2.9 after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: Children born via cesarean section had a higher odds ratio of being diagnosed with ASD compared to those born vaginally.
